items.title: Palantir Just Dropped 25% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalantir stock fell 25% in the past month, even though third-quarter revenue grew 96% and the company raised its full-year guidance. Slower bookings, worries about the Pentagon budget under a Democratic Congress, and Anthropic’s IPO gave investors reasons to pay less, while Datadog fell even further in the same AI software selloff.
